title: Regulated Customer Onboarding Roadmap — Risk-adjusted OKR mapping and quarterly milestones
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Create a prioritized, risk-adjusted quarterly roadmap and playbook for onboarding regulated customers (financial, healthcare, and government) onto Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). This ticket consolidates OKR mappings, acceptance gates, cross-functional milestones, and a triage matrix for handling compliance blockers during customer onboarding. The output will be a living roadmap that the Solutions, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Security, and Infra teams can use to schedule dedicated onboarding waves and estimate calendar lead time for each cohort.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A published quarter-level roadmap that maps onboarding milestones to measurable OKRs (time-to-onboard, % automation, SLA attainment). 2) Runbook with explicit acceptance gates (network connectivity, KMS integration, audit log verification, canary inference workload). 3) Risk matrix and mitigation plans for top 5 regulatory blockers. 4) Template SOW/operational checklist for Sales Engineering and CS. 5) Stakeholder signoff from Security, Solutions, and Product leadership.
milestones: Milestone 1 (by 2025-03-15): Draft OKR mapping and prioritized cohort definitions (Tier A: high-compliance, Tier B: medium, Tier C: low)
Milestone 2 (by 2025-04-01): Produce onboarding playbook v0.1 with network & KMS acceptance steps and integration test checklist
Milestone 3 (by 2025-05-01): Run two trial onboardings (one VPC, one on-prem pilot) and capture time-to-onboard metrics
Milestone 4 (by 2025-06-15): Iterate playbook to v1.0 incorporating pilot learnings; publish SOW templates and expected calendar lead times
Milestone 5 (by 2025-06-30): Leadership signoff and inclusion in private-2025.06 release notes
risks_mitigations: Risk: KMS/HSM integration takes longer than estimated due to customer HSM vendor nuances. Mitigation: Pre-built KMS playbooks for top 3 HSM vendors and an escalation lane to Security for attestation.

Risk: Networking/firewall constraints at customer side block proof-of-concept. Mitigation: Provide a staged network-testing toolkit and offer an on-site networking engineer as paid service for Tier A customers.
Risk: Model performance regressions when quantized on customer hardware. Mitigation: Bake a model-compatibility gate into onboarding and maintain a catalog of verified model-variant recommendations.
Risk: Audit/logging requirements require custom retention or format. Mitigation: Add audit schema template and a plan for extended log export to customer SIEMs.
Risk: Capacity scheduling conflicts across Dedicated and Private pools. Mitigation: Reserve a pilot capacity pool and document pre-empt policy in SOWs.
okrs_mapping: OKR 1: Time-to-onboard — Reduce average calendar onboarding time for Tier A customers from 12 weeks to 6 weeks by end of Q3. Key result: automation of 5 manual acceptance steps.
OKR 2: SLA readiness — Ensure 95% of onboarded regulated customers meet baseline latency and uptime SLOs within 30 days post-onboard.
OKR 3: Cost predictability — Publish per-tenant capacity guidance and expected monthly cost ranges for Tier A/B/C by release private-2025.06.
OKR 4: Compliance readiness — Provide signed runbook and audit checklist for 80% of new regulated customers at initial sign-off.
deliverables: Quarterly onboarding roadmap doc (public to GTM & private to delivery teams)
Onboarding playbook v1.0 (runbook + scripts + test harness)
SOW and pricing template for pilot and full engagements
Pilot retrospective and metrics dashboard (time-to-onboard, failed gates, root cause)
